desc: Redraw this dandelion rabbit as a detailed 16-bit indie game sprite: realistic rabbit proportions, same face, cream white fur, pink inner ears, small dandelion flower, small plain eyes, same pose and silhouette. Muted natural palette, thin dark navy outline, 3-4 shade steps with pixel clusters, deeper shadows under head and belly, highlights on ears and flower, subtle fur shading. No gradients, no ground shadow.
